scope: Frozen B1 dimensional vs independently integrated audited compact dimensionless 12-state trajectory
solver_tolerance_convention: Same numeric scalar tolerances for dimensional x(t) and dimensionless y(tau); tau=k_nt_deg*t. No NonNegative option or clipping.
roundtrip_tolerance: 64*eps(max(1,abs(original))) per element for state, time and rate roundtrips
rate_backtransform_scale: max(max(abs(canonical_rate(:,j))),1) per rate; also save raw residuals
invariant_scale: max(abs(initial_invariant),1) per invariant, including zero initial I6; save raw residuals
physicality_roundoff_allowance: 64*eps(max([1;abs(initial_full_state);abs(invariant_constants)])) uM; report every minimum and negative count, without repair
